'''Ando Prime Centrum''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] track on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]]. The course was located around the center of a [[City/Legends|city]]. This course was the first race in the [[Invitational Podracing Circuit]] tournament. [[Slide Paramita]] favored this course.

==Other tracks of Ando Prime==

*[[Semipro Podracing Circuit|Semipro Circuit]] track: [[Howler Gorge/Legends|Howler Gorge]]
*[[Galactic Podracing Circuit/Legends|Galactic Circuit]] track: [[Andobi Mountain Run/Legends|Andobi Mountain Run]]
